title: Include pulls a LocalCommand from an agent-written conf.d file
reason_not_testable: The Include target is resolved inside ssh's config parsing, which the command text does not show, so no PreToolUse fixture can prove the included file is covered. The stdout-redaction half is the same mechanism as LEAK-1230 and LEAK-1234. Non-hook controls: config writes are denied (TAMP-0071 fixtures) and the hook cannot inspect included files.
